story_type: would-be rescuers swim after a paddle boarder and need rescue themselves, helicopter basket hoist
hook: Two men swam out to save her. Then they needed saving too.
narration: She drifted out on a paddle board. Two men swam after her.
[short pause] Then they needed saving too.
Air Station Houston sent a helicopter.
A rescue basket means a tired swimmer only has to climb in and sit.
outcome: The crew rescued the woman and hoisted both men out of the Gulf.
title: Two men swam out to save her
description:
A woman was swept out on a paddle board in the Gulf of America off Texas on May 2, 2026, and two men who swam out to rescue her got into trouble too. A Coast Guard Air Station Houston helicopter crew rescued the woman and hoisted both men.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Houston, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1005204/coast-guard-air-station-houston-rescues-woman-and-hoists-two-men

question_comment: Would you swim out after someone, or wait for help?
